meaning:
βιωτικός, -ή, -όν
(βιός),
pertaining to life, hence, worldly (Field, Notes, 171): Luk.21:34, 1Co.6:3, 4.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: things that pertain to this life
of things pertaining to this life

elsewhere.note: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
